title: Ocean Pearl - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Ocean Pearl" is your perfect Seacrest escape, located between Rosemary and Alys Beaches. With a spacious main house and cozy carriage house, it’s ideal for your relaxation and fun. Spend mornings at the Lagoon pool moments away, afternoons biking to the beach, and evenings on the rooftop patio enjoying stunning sunsets. Whether it’s a family trip or group getaway, "Ocean Pearl" is your slice of paradise on 30A. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Luxury Living: Expansive main house plus a private carriage house, with a spacious layout ensuring everyone has their own private retreat.Gourmet Kitchen: Chefs in the group will be impressed with the kitchen items that are on hand.Rooftop Patio: Sunset views, outdoor dining, and a wet bar for evening relaxation.Steps to the Pool: Just a 2-minute walk to the 12,000 sq ft tropical Lagoon pool.Prime Location: Walkable to boutique shopping and gourmet dining.Easy Beach Access: with convenient seasonal tram service right off the door.7 Beach Bikes Included: Explore nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach with ease.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Loved the perfect location near the pool and beach! The carriage house made it ideal for our group." – Kelli R.⭐ "This house was fully stocked and in a beautiful, safe community. We can’t wait to come back!" – Jessica A.⭐ "The house was spotless and steps from everything we needed. Best vacation home we’ve stayed in!" – Stacy K.*** LIVING AREAS ***Relax in comfort with stylish, open-concept living spaces designed to bring people together. With plenty of room for group gatherings, these spaces are perfect for hosting friends, spending time with family, or simply unwinding in a modern and inviting atmosphere.Open-plan living room with cozy, contemporary furnitureFlat-screen TV for entertainmentAdditional living area in the private carriage house*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook and dine with ease in not one, but two fully-equipped kitchens, complete with modern appliances, ample counter space, and all the essentials you need. Perfect for preparing family meals, hosting dinner parties, or simply enjoying a relaxed cooking experience with friends. These kitchens are designed to make every meal a joy, whether you're whipping up a quick snack or a gourmet feast.Gourmet kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances and wine fridgeDining table seats 8, bar seating for 5Carriage house full kitchen with bar seating for 3*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Ocean Pearl features 5 spacious bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, providing ample space for relaxation and privacy. With the ability to comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests, it's the perfect destination for family gatherings, group vacations, or special celebrations.1st Floor:Primary Suite: King bed, En-suite bath, smart TV, direct patio accessHalf Bath2nd Floor:Primary Suite: King bed, smart TV, private balcony and En-suite bath with his and hers sinks, separate water closet and walk-in showerTwin Guest Room: 2 Twin beds, smart TV and access to the balconyBunk Room: Twin-over-Full custom bunk bed, smart TV, access to the balcony and shared bathroomBunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin custom built bunkShared Full Bathroom: With double vanity, separate water closet and walk-in showerCarriage House:Bedroom: King bed, En-suite bath with walk-in shower, flat-screen TVBunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin custom built bunk bed*** OUTDOOR AMENITIES ***Ocean Pearl provides the ultimate outdoor luxury with spaces designed for relaxation and entertainment.Rooftop covered patio, dining space, sunset views and indoor wet bar – Unwind in style with panoramic sunset views, cocktails in hand, and a rooftop dining experience under the open sky.Large driveway with parking for 4 vehicles – Convenience meets comfort with spacious parking, perfect for hosting family and friends.7 adult beach bikes for cruising 30A – Explore the beauty of 30A with ease on our beach bikes, perfect for scenic rides and coastal adventures.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, Ocean Pearl offers the perfect blend of convenience and vibrant local charm. Nestled just steps away from pristine white sand beaches and boutique shopping, this destination puts everything you need within easy reach.2-minute walk to the 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool – A stunning paradise with a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers, plus a poolside café and picnic areas.Beach Access – Enjoy a seasonal tram for easy transportation or take a short 10-minute stroll to the emerald Gulf waters.Peddler’s Pavilion – Just a 4-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife.Scenic Walking & Nature Trails – Picturesque paths just steps from the house, ideal for exploration and relaxation.Walkable, Bike-Friendly Community – Conveniently access beautiful destinations all around.South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique and stunning natural feature of the area.Rosemary Beach (8-min walk) and Alys Beach (12-min walk) – Explore charming coastal communities nearby.Carillon Beach (7-min drive) – More coastal beauty just minutes away.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during booking.We DO NOT accept wire transfers.This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes - a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home. There is also a camera at the corner of the exterior of the home that faces the property. *** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 55346STRO #: STR-055346

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
